title: Palawan vs Cebu: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Palawan for bucket-list scenery and world-class island hopping (El Nido, Coron); Cebu for variety, convenience, and easier logistics. Do both with 12+ days.

categories.name: Beaches & Scenery
categories.summary: El Nido limestone lagoons and Coron are world-class. Cebu has waterfalls and accessible beaches but can't match Palawan's drama.

categories.name: Diving & Snorkeling
categories.summary: Coron wreck diving and Tubbataha reef vs Moalboal sardine run and Malapascua thresher sharks.

categories.name: Wildlife Experiences
categories.summary: Cebu has whale sharks and Bohol tarsiers; Palawan has the Underground River, fireflies, and endemic birds.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Budget flights and city infrastructure make Cebu meaningfully cheaper, especially for transit from Manila.

categories.name: Getting There
categories.summary: Multiple budget carriers to Cebu vs Air Swift premium or long van ride for Palawan.

categories.name: Activities & Adventure
categories.summary: Palawan for sea exploration; Cebu for Kawasan Falls canyoneering and mixed land/water adventure.

categories.name: City Life
categories.summary: Cebu City is the Philippines' second city. El Nido and Coron are charming small towns.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: Cebu's hub location gives access to Bohol, Siquijor, Malapascua, Oslob in a single trip.

categories.name: Weather Window
categories.summary: Cebu is more protected from typhoons and has year-round whale sharks.

categories.name: Family-Friendliness
categories.summary: City amenities and land activities make Cebu easier for families vs boat-heavy Palawan tours.

faq.question: Is Palawan or Cebu better for first-time visitors?
faq.answer: Cebu for variety and convenience; Palawan for jaw-dropping scenery. Cebu if you have under 10 days, Palawan if you have more.

faq.question: How much per day in Palawan vs Cebu?
Can I do both in one trip?
faq.answer: Yes — 12–14 days, fly via Manila. Do Palawan first then end in Cebu for easier logistics home.
